policy.boundary_policy: Inclusive target >= minimum and Sun <= darkness. Within corresponding angular goal, independent labels are indeterminate; compare count intervals, never force agreement.
policy.rationale: Planner-scale 5 arcsec stellar/Sun and 60 arcsec Moon comparison goals inherited from Missions 33/34. Not physical uncertainty bounds. No post-evaluation tolerance fitting.
policy.sampling_policy: Uniform inclusive UTC JD grid, nearest sampled mid-transit (first on exact tie). Fractions are sample counts, not time integrals. 241-point grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not continuous coverage certification.
policy.timing: Explicit UTC observing inputs in 2024; synthetic event geometry, no catalogue ephemeris or barycentric arrival conversion. Zero timing uncertainty is a supplied placeholder, not an established physical bound.
